evidence.text: Relic: Big Lug's Door - Ogryn; Availability: Near-Unique; Effect: +2 AC; Ogryn only; counts as a Slab Shield. If you did not move this turn, one Small or Medium ally directly behind you has Full Cover. Once per short rest when a ranged attack misses you, move 5 ft toward the attacker without provoking opportunity attacks.
